title: Strictly and non-strictly positive definite functions on spheres
metadata_check: arXiv API 2026-08-18 (v5, dated 2013-10-01) and Crossref DOI 10.3150/12-BEJSP06, Bernoulli 19.
content_check: Full text downloaded (24 pp.) and read at the relevant places. Theorem 1(a): the class Psi_d of isotropic positive definite functions on S^d is exactly the set of Gegenbauer series in C_n^{(d-1)/2}(cos theta)/C_n^{(d-1)/2}(1) with nonnegative coefficients b_{n,d} summing to 1 (this is Schoenberg's 1942 characterisation). Theorem 2(b),(c): the inclusions Psi^+_{d+1} subset Psi^+_d and Psi^-_{d+1} subset Psi^-_d hold and are strict. Section 4.3 covers completely monotone functions, which are positive definite on spheres of every dimension.
